definition: AND >= 1 CANONICAL_ACCEPT in a court-authored role (holding | reasoning | reasoning_proposition | proposition)
AND >= 1 CANONICAL_ACCEPT in an OUTCOME role (relief_granted | court_action)
AND 0 ROLE_MISMATCH anywhere on the document
note: `relief` is NO LONGER an outcome role. semantic-role v2: it is RELIEF SOUGHT, a prayer, and is adjudicated as a party submission.
